fixtures.preview: United host Roma on Champions League matchday 4 (8pm Tue 3 Nov UK, 7am Wed 4 Nov Sydney) in poor form under Michael Carrick.
talking_points: United are on a nine-match winless run (three draws, six losses) after a 2-0 defeat at Chelsea, with three points from three league-phase games.
Amad is uncertain after coming off at Chelsea; Sesko, Dorgu and Shaw are injury concerns and Rashford needs assessment. Martinez is available for this match.
Roma, under Gian Piero Gasperini, arrive off a 5-2 win over Udinese; Kone and Svilar are out and Dybala is uncertain.
Donyell Malen is Roma's main threat with eight Serie A and three Champions League goals, per an Opta preview; line-ups are due on matchday.

fixtures.preview: Aston Villa visit Old Trafford on Sunday 8 Nov at 4:30pm UK time (3:30am Mon 9 Nov Sydney).
The trip to Anfield is set for Sunday 22 November at 4:30pm UK time (3:30am Mon 23 Nov Sydney).
Matchday 5 in Lisbon, listed by UEFA at 21:00 CET (7am Thu 26 Nov Sydney).
Brentford visit on Saturday 28 Nov at 3pm UK time (2am Sun 29 Nov Sydney), United's first 3pm Saturday kick-off of the season.
Sydney look to bounce back at home on Friday night after losing their first game of the season at Melbourne City.
talking_points: Sydney lost 2-1 at Melbourne City on Saturday 31 Oct after Al-Hassan Toure's first-half opener, conceding twice after the break.
Coach Patrick Kisnorbo has backed his young side to learn from the defeat, per the club site.
Toure also had a second goal ruled out for offside; no line-up for Friday is confirmed.

notes: Search and fetch tools were weak again: many results were old seasons, and manutd.com, the BBC, Sydney FC's fixtures list, the supermarket sites and several sports pages could not be read. Sections not fully re-checked are shorter than their limits rather than padded.

Man Utd v Roma: team news is from a dave.sport preview and is not confirmed; line-ups are due on matchday. Other United and Sydney FC fixtures and times are carried from the last run and weren't re-verified; Stan Sport and Paramount+ are assumed as broadcasters.
A Sydney Kings v SE Melbourne Phoenix game on 8 Nov appears on a third-party listing but could not be confirmed at the source, so it is not listed.
Arts, deals and groceries were partly refreshed this run (Time Out, OzBargain and catalogue sites); the Coles and Woolworths catalogues showed few healthy lines and no was-prices.

Sydney FC v Mariners: date, time and Paramount+ confirmed on a Flicks listing. Fixtures after Brisbane were not fully verified, and one matchweek (around 27-29 Nov) may be missing between Brisbane and Melbourne Victory. The Auckland kick-off is treated as New Zealand time.

Big matches and live sport are carried from the last run (UEFA times were checked then). A search could not confirm Stan Sport for Wallabies v England in 2026; the 3:10pm UK kick-off was matched by two sources. No Sydney tennis, rugby union, Matildas or Socceroos games were found.

Arts: Beetlejuice and Whispering Jack details come from search results because the venue pages couldn't be opened. Frontier Touring lists presales for Beth Orton (4 Nov, Mar 2027) and Jonah Kagen (5 Nov, Apr 2027); their Sydney dates weren't confirmed.
Groceries: Woolworths and Aldi items for 4-10 Nov come from catalogue sites (no was-prices shown); Coles' 4-10 Nov specials could not be found. Items that ended 3 Nov were dropped.
Local: school events were re-read from the Term 4 calendars and Week 3 Principal Updates and are unchanged. Nothing was found for the second school or for South Eveleigh in November.

Not found: Sydney matcha pop-ups in November, a Sydney junior parkrun, Pokemon or Minecraft events, and kids' football-boot sales, so the section for the son is empty and the daughter section is carried over.
Deals that only linked the OzBargain front page (Gladiator, Viewfinder, Hurricane's Grill) were dropped. Horizon entries are carried over and were not re-checked, apart from the marathon ballot date.
